title: the superhot key is named in words, left of 1, on the F1 list and beside the Settings row
why: Follow-up to cw-shkey (his note 2026-10-18: "superhot mode needs a toggle key."). The picture of the Settings pane and the F1 list showed the key as a lone backquote tick, hard to see and read as "`(left of 1)". The key left of 1 is now named in words in both places: LEFT OF 1 on the Superhot row of the F1 list (the same words the Keys window uses) and key: left of 1 under the Superhot row in Settings. No new key and no new row.
now: The Superhot key is named in words on the F1 list and beside the Settings row: left of 1.

edits.replacement:
html+='
key: left of 1
'; // cw-shkey2: in words, the tick alone was hard to see
